items.title: CME Group (CME) Enters AI Compute Futures
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) is partnering with Silicon Data to launch Compute futures that allow businesses and investors to manage exposure to AI compute costs. The company is expanding 24/7 trading access to silver futures after the earlier rollout of continuous gold trading. CME is preparing to introduce the world's first index-based Hockey futures tied to sports data and risk management trends. These moves show how CME Group is tying core market infrastructure to fast growing themes in AI,...

items.title: The currency of the AI age
items.summary: There's an effort underway to create a futures market for AI compute — the processing capacity needed to train and run AI models — akin to how investors buy and sell commodities like oil or grain.

items.title: StoneX Q3 Earnings Surge as R.J. O'Brien Synergies Move Toward $50M

items.title: Is SNEX a Buy as Earnings Growth Collides With a Premium Valuation?
items.summary: StoneX pairs strong earnings growth and expanding scale with a premium valuation, leaving investors to weigh momentum against margin and credit risks.

items.title: SNEX Drops 14% in One Week: Is the Pullback a Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: StoneX shares fell 14% in a week despite strong Q3 earnings growth, as valuation, retail weakness and rate sensitivity temper the buying case.
